data.long_meaning: Derived from the name 'Ali' which means 'Exalted', 'Noble', or 'Sublime'. In Islamic tradition, Ali is considered the cousin and son-in-law of Prophet Muhammad and the fourth caliph. Aliyya is a feminine form of this revered name. The name Aliyya carries the meaning “Exalted, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aliyya usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
